Get every updates live from the USA vs Italy 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup game: Where to Watch, kickoff time, and match prediction. We have all the details on the Group D match between both national teams at Uber Arena, in Berlin Germany.

What time is the USA vs Italy 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup game?

Team USA and Italy's National Basketball Women's Team will face off this Sunday, September 6, 2026 . This is their game in the Groups round for the 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup for the United States and is scheduled for:

Where to watch live the USA vs Italy 2026 FIBA Wo.men's Basketball World Cup game?

Fans in the United States can watch the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup 2026 in Germany live on TNT , and streaming on HBO Max .

Team USA , led by a star-studded roster of WNBA talent, will look to take another step toward defending its title when it faces Italy on Sunday, September 6 , in its second group-stage game of the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup .

The Americans enter the matchup riding the momentum of a dominant 94-61 victory over China in their tournament opener, extending their remarkable run in the competition. The United States, winners of the last four FIBA Women's World Cup titles , has not lost a game in the tournament since 2006 .

Four U.S. players scored in double figures against China, led by Caitlin Clark , who posted a double-double with 14 points and 11 assists . Her 11 assists set a new record for the most by an American player in FIBA Women's World Cup history. Rhyne Howard and Paige Bueckers each added 14 points .

The United States is already familiar with Italy this year. The two teams met at the FIBA Women's World Cup Qualifying Tournament in Puerto Rico in March, where Team USA cruised to a 93-59 victory behind 15 points from Kahleah Copper , one of five American players to score in double figures.

For Italy, the player to watch will be Cecilia Zandalasini , the Golden State Valkyries standout who plays under Team USA assistant coach Natalie Nakase in the WNBA. The veteran forward enters the game in top form after scoring 19 points in Italy's 63-54 victory over Czechia in its group-stage opener.

Very talented team. Everybody's going to get up and play their best when they're playing us

"(Cecilia) Zandalasini's had an incredible year with the Valkyries. ... She can stretch the floor. She can score in the midrange. She has great size. She's athletic."

What time is USA vs. Italy?

Team USA will face Italy on Sunday, September 6 , at Berlin Arena in Berlin.

Date: Sunday, September 6

Time: 2:45 p.m. ET (11:45 a.m. PT)

Venue: Berlin Arena (Berlin)

How to watch USA vs. Italy

In the United States, TNT holds the exclusive English-language broadcast rights. All 36 games of the tournament will also stream on HBO Max , while 17 games , including every Team USA contest, will air on TNT and truTV .

TV Channels: TNT and truTV

Team USA FIBA Women's World Cup Schedule

Friday, September 4: United States 94-61 China.

Sunday, September 6: United States vs. Italy | 2:45 p.m. ET .

Monday, September 7: United States vs. Czechia | 2:45 p.m. ET .

The winner of each group will advance directly to the quarterfinals , scheduled for September 10 . Teams that finish second and third in their groups will compete in a qualification round on September 8 to determine the final four quarterfinal spots.

The semifinals will be played on September 12 , while the third-place game and the championship game are scheduled for September 13 .

articles.body:
Get every updates live from the USA vs Czechia 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup game: Where to Watch, kickoff time, and match prediction. We have all the details on the Group D match between both national teams at Uber Arena, in Berlin Germany.

What time is the USA vs Czechia 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup game?

Team USA and Czechia's National Basketball Women's Team will face off this Monday, September 7, 2026 . This is their game in the Groups round for the 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup for the United States and is scheduled for:

Where to watch live the USA vs Czechia 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup game?

Fans in the United States can watch the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup 2026 in Germany live on TNT, and streaming on HBO Max.

Team USA narrowly avoided a stunning upset against Italy at the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup , but the challenge only gets tougher. Less than 24 hours after that hard-fought victory, the Americans return to the court to face Czechia , aiming to keep their perfect record intact and move one step closer to a historic fifth consecutive gold medal .

The Stars and Stripes will play their third group-stage game on Monday, Sept. 7 , looking to extend an impressive World Cup winning streak that dates back to 2006 .

The United States is coming off a 55-52 victory over Italy , its lowest-scoring performance at a Women's World Cup since 1984 . Jackie Young led the way with 10 points, four rebounds, three assists, and two steals , while Angel Reese added eight points, three rebounds, two blocks, and one steal to help secure a spot in the quarterfinals.

"Obviously, Italy really made things difficult for us and made it hard to score," Breanna Stewart said. "They're a great team... This is a very tough tournament, and we all know that."

FIBA Women's World Cup: What time does Team USA vs. Czechia start?

Team USA will take on Czechia on Monday, Sept. 7 , at Berlin Arena in Berlin, Germany.

Time: 2:45 p.m. ET (11:45 a.m. PT)

Venue: Berlin Arena, Berlin

How to watch Team USA vs. Czechia live

In the United States, TNT holds the exclusive English-language broadcast rights. All 36 tournament games will stream on HBO Max , while 17 matchups , including every Team USA game, will also air on TNT and truTV .

Team USA schedule at the FIBA Women's World Cup

Friday, Sept. 4: United States 94-61 China

Sunday, Sept. 6: United States 55-52 Italy

Monday, Sept. 7: United States vs. Czechia | 2:45 p.m. ET

The winner of each group advances directly to the quarterfinals , scheduled for Sept. 10 . Teams finishing second and third will compete in a qualification round on Sept. 8 to determine the remaining four quarterfinal berths. The semifinals will be played on Sept. 12 , with the third-place game and championship final set for Sept. 13 .

USA vs. Czechia lineups: Are Caitlin Clark and Angel Reese playing today?

Both players are available for Team USA , although head coach Kara Lawson has opted for a more experienced starting lineup for this matchup.

Caitlin Clark's World Cup stats

Caitlin Clark is averaging 7.5 points and six assists in 21.9 minutes per game through Team USA's first two contests. The star guard is shooting 4-for-15 from the field , 3-for-10 from beyond the arc , and 4-for-6 from the free-throw line .

Her best performance came in the 94-61 win over China , where she posted a 14-point, 11-assist double-double in just 25 minutes. Against Italy, however, she struggled, finishing with one point and one assist in 19 minutes.

Assistant coaches: Natalie Nakase, Nate Tibbetts, Stephanie White

Led by Kara Lawson , Team USA blends veteran leadership with emerging talent. The roster features established stars such as two-time WNBA MVP Breanna Stewart , four-time WNBA champion Chelsea Gray , and former Defensive Player of the Year Napheesa Collier , along with the next generation of women's basketball stars, including Caitlin Clark, Paige Bueckers, and Angel Reese .

articles.title: Who won the USA vs Spain game? Highlights and results of the FIBA Womens Basketball World Cup Semifinals.
articles.summary: Thank you for following our minute-by-minute coverage! Well see you tomorrow for the grand finale! USA vs France The final between the U.S. and France
articles.body:
Get every live update from the USA vs Spain 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup Semifinals game: Where to Watch, kickoff time, and match prediction. We have all the details on the match between both national teams looking for a place in the final match at Uber Arena, in Berlin Germany .

What time is the USA vs Spain 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup Semifinals game?

Team U SA and Spain's National Basketball Women's Team will face off this Saturday, September 12, 2026. This is the definitive game to make it to the finals of the 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup for the United States and is scheduled for:

Where to watch live the USA vs Spain 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup Semifinals game?

Fans in the United States can watch the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup 2026 in Germany live on TNT, and streaming on HBO Max.

USA vs Spain H2H and rivalry: record between both teams in the FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup

USA is 5-0 against Spain in Women's World Cup history and has never lost to them in senior FIBA competition. Official FIBA head-to-head lists the United States with 11 wins and Spain with 0 across all meetings.

2014 final (Istanbul): USA 77-64 Spain (rematch of this year's semifinal)

2010 semifinals: USA 106-70 Spain

2002 quarterfinals: USA 94-55 Spain

1998 eighth-final round: USA 79-68 Spain

1994 preliminary round: USA 92-71 Spain

They also met in March 2026 World Cup qualifying in Puerto Rico , with USA winning 84-70 . The rivalry is lopsided but not empty: Spain reached the 2014 fina l and won World Cup medals in the 2010s (including bronze on home soil in 2018). Saturday is their first World Cup meeting since that 2014 title game. Stewart played in the 2014 win as a 20-year-old; Alba Torrens is still on Spain's roster.

USA is the heavy favorite to reach a fifth straight World Cup final . They are 4-0 in Berlin, averaging over 90 points, and just posted a 108-56 quarterfinal rout of Hungary. Spain is 3-1 (the loss was to Mali in group play) and earned the rematch with an 89-66 quarterfinal win over Australia.

USA has the depth, athleticism, and transition game; Spain's best chance is to slow the pace, protect the ball, and hang around into the fourth quarter the way they did in the March qualifier.

USA vs Spain lineups: Are Caitlin Clark and Angel Reese playing?

Yes. Both are on the 12-player roster and have played throughout the tournament. They are not expected to start.

USA has used the same starting five in every game of this unbeaten run and is unlikely to change it:

Caitlin Clark, Paige Bueckers , and Angel Reese (along with Aliyah Boston) have come off the bench and produced. Clark already posted a 14-point, 11-assist double-double in the opener vs. China. Reese has given them rebounding and energy. Expect that rotation again unless the game script forces an earlier look at the younger stars. Spain's key pieces include Alba Torrens , Megan Gustafson , Iyana Martín , and Awa Fam .

Tip-off is Saturday, Sept. 12, 2 p.m. ET (8 p.m. local in Berlin) at Berlin Arena. Winner plays the France-Germany winner in Sunday's final.
